_comment: Manual sidecar SQL migrations applied outside drizzle-kit _journal.json. Listed here so audit-contract-map.mjs treats them as documented_sidecar (WARN) rather than unknown_unjournaled_sql (FAIL).

sidecars.reason: Code-intelligence GIN/trgm and B-tree indexes. Drizzle ORM cannot express GIN trgm ops (USING gin(col gin_trgm_ops)) natively — must live outside the journal.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname LIKE '%trgm%' LIMIT 5;"

sidecars.reason: Code-intelligence supplemental tables (codebase_chunk_index, ast_node_cache). Applied manually to avoid collision with drizzle-kit journal snapshot state at index 16.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('codebase_chunk_index','ast_node_cache');"

sidecars.reason: Courtroom 3D animation tables (courtroom_models, courtroom_animations, courtroom_anim_type enum). Applied manually because drizzle-kit journal index 16 was already taken; enum creation requires sidecar pattern.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('courtroom_models','courtroom_animations');"

sidecars.reason: Adds manifold4 real[] column to research_summaries for SOM 4D coordinate storage. Applied manually alongside journal entry 18 to avoid snapshot regeneration.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='research_summaries' AND column_name='manifold4';"

sidecars.reason: LLM context cache table (llm_context_cache) with JSONB payload. Applied manually because drizzle-kit snapshot was not regenerated after this addition.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='llm_context_cache';"

sidecars.reason: Repairs legacy text/jsonb columns to pgvector types to align with Drizzle schema. Covers evidence_vectors, legal_documents, and document_embeddings.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='legal_documents' AND column_name='content_embedding';"

sidecars.reason: Applies HNSW indexes to core vector tables for performance. CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS safe for live data.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexdef LIKE '%hnsw%';"

sidecars.reason: Standardizes identity system on UUIDs and resolves high-severity type drifts (varchar/text, integer/bigint) to achieve full Drizzle parity.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users' AND column_name='id';"

sidecars.reason: Durable LLM synthesis memory audit trail log table. Captures run_id, query, profile, ace_packet, tool_calls, source_refs, cache_keys, and model.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='llm_synthesis_events';"

sidecars.reason: Tracks granular execution details for each step of the RAG pipeline. Captures args, result_summary, duration_ms, status, and error.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='tool_traces' AND column_name IN ('status','error');"

sidecars.reason: Defines code_retrieval_chunks table with FTS indexes, pgvector HNSW index, and search_code_hybrid_pg RRF function.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec 94823593eb8e_legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT proname FROM pg_proc WHERE proname='search_code_hybrid_pg';"

sidecars.reason: Defines canonical summary_cards table for normalized codebase summary cards, top-N retrieval cards, and TOON packet rollups.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='summary_cards';"

sidecars.reason: Adds saved_citation_annotations and evidence_board_edges to support citation -> annotation -> graph edge -> Redis packet flow.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('saved_citation_annotations','evidence_board_edges');"

sidecars.reason: Adds cache_layer_used column to synthesis_logs to support fast analytics filters on cache hitting.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='synthesis_logs' AND column_name='cache_layer_used';"

sidecars.reason: Mirrors Claude-Mem/OpenCode observations into Postgres as the durable Engram/ACE observation layer. SQLite remains an import source only.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='agent_memory_observations';"

sidecars.reason: Adds the pgvector embedding column and HNSW index for agent_memory_observations so worker API writes can persist embeddinggemma:latest vectors directly in Postgres.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='agent_memory_observations' AND column_name='embedding';"

sidecars.reason: Migration adds agent_observations table for OpenCode / Claude-mem ingest.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='agent_observations';"

sidecars.reason: Phase19B: Add card_source_refs mapping and nullable card_id columns for reliable sourceRef -> card joins; best-effort HNSW index for summary_cards.embedding.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='card_source_refs';"

sidecars.reason: Phase19D: Add scenario_cache table to bypass preflight logic on exact match query hashes.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='scenario_cache';"

sidecars.reason: Additive live alignment for nes_chrom_packets and nes_chrom_kag_dag_hits contract mirrors. Repairs missing live indexes and the metadata column without changing intent.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname IN ('idx_nes_chrom_packets_lane_ids_gin','nes_chrom_packets_embedding_hnsw','nes_chrom_kag_dag_hits_chunk_idx','nes_chrom_kag_dag_hits_source_ref_idx','nes_chrom_kag_dag_hits_node_key_idx','nes_chrom_kag_dag_hits_evidence_gin','nes_chrom_kag_dag_hits_metadata_gin');"

sidecars.reason: Drizzle migration for agent_pickup_queue table to support agent pickup loop.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='agent_pickup_queue';"

sidecars.reason: Drizzle migration for task_semantic_packets table to support semantic packet generation and tracking.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='task_semantic_packets';"

sidecars.reason: Expands the task semantic packet mirror with payload metadata, packet links, and queue lane fields.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT to_regclass('public.task_cluster_links');"
